name: Dr. Basab Raj Ghosh
summary: Dr. Basab Raj Ghosh is a radiation oncologist with MBBS training at NRS Medical College, Kolkata, an MD in Radiotherapy from the University of Calcutta and a DNB in Radiotherapy. His background includes training in radiotherapy, chemotherapy, pain management and palliative care. His additional training covers hospital management, counselling and psychotherapy, clinical diabetes, geriatric medicine and clinical cardiology, together with an honorary fellowship in family medicine. He achieved first place in the MD Radiotherapy examination and has presented at national conferences and published on cancer treatment. His previous clinical experience includes Cancer Centre Welfare Home and Research Institute, Thakurpukur, Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute and Columbia Asia. His professional memberships include IMA, IMA College of General Practitioners, AROI, ASCO, ESMO, ICON, ISMPO and ISO.
